description: Returns the two-hourly temperature, wind speed, and wind direction shown in the hourly view of the forecast page's weather by elevation grid, for one day in the free forecast window, with local times, ISO timestamps, the time zone, and the chosen elevation. Takes a date from the route's visible days and an optional elevation band of base, mid, or summit. Informational only.

activity.description: Optional activity mode for the route forecast. Accepted values are the route's activities entries from search_objectives. When omitted, the route's default visible activity is used.

date.description: Day to return, as YYYY-MM-DD, from the days in the free forecast window.

elevation_band.description: Optional elevation band for the hourly temperature and wind: base, mid, or summit. The forecast page opens on summit, which is the default.

slug.description: Public objective slug returned by search_objectives.

estimated.description: Present when the hour's temperature is a diurnal estimate from the day's summit mean, because no hourly source covered the hour.

source.description: Present when the row's temperature comes from another source than provenance.sourceName (an NWS hourly period used where the model had no hour).

provenance.description: Where the rows come from: the hourly source's own roster entry and health row, never inferred. A row from another source names it in its source field; an estimated row says so in its estimated field.

fetchedAt.description: When this forecast fetched the hourly source; null when the source is unknown.

model.description: The model, present only when the forecast requested one named model.

sourceName.description: The forecast roster name of the source whose hourly rows the day carries, or null when the forecast recorded none (for example a day of diurnal estimates only, or a forecast cached before the source was recorded).

upstreamIssuedAt.description: The hourly source's own issue time from its health row; null when the source publishes none or the source is unknown.
